clue.text: Exhausted after official turned down appeal

indicators.note: after places the word for exhausted behind the official in the answer

parts.note: a ref, short for referee, is a match official
something exhausted is used up, so used

explanation.surface: A weary official rejects a player's appeal after the match.
explanation.walkthrough: 'after' places the word for exhausted behind the official, so the charade runs REF then USED; the appeal is merely what was turned down.
explanation.definitionFit: To refuse a request is to turn it down, the two phrases being direct synonyms in the past tense.

clue.text: Sweet music to soothe baby

definitions.meaning: a hard stick-shaped sweet sold at British seaside resorts
to soothe a baby by swaying it gently in your arms or a cradle

explanation.surface: Gentle sweet music is played to calm an infant.
explanation.definitionFit: Rock is a seaside candy, a music genre, and a verb for gently swaying a child.

clue.text: Edict imprisoning European emergency worker

indicators.note: one word imprisoning another holds it inside

parts.note: a firman is an edict issued by an oriental sovereign

explanation.surface: An order locks up a European rescuer.
explanation.definitionFit: A firefighter is a worker called out to fires and other emergencies.

clue.text: When boat has gone out, sailor can become lover

indicators.note: the boat going out of the sailor means it is removed from him

parts.note: a boatswain is a ship's officer, a sailor
taken as written

explanation.surface: Once his ship has left, a sailor is free to court someone.
explanation.walkthrough: BOATSWAIN loses BOAT to leave SWAIN; 'When' and 'can become' only link.
explanation.definitionFit: A swain is a poetic word for a young suitor, a lover.

clue.text: Steps on to platform and tries playing

indicators.note: letters playing about are moved into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Someone alights at a station while trying out a game.
explanation.definitionFit: To detrain is to get off a train, which means stepping down onto the platform.

clue.text: University's set essays about Greek hero

indicators.note: essays placed about the university letter means they surround it

parts.note: theses are long academic essays
U is the standard abbreviation for university; the 's is read as 'is'

explanation.surface: A university sets its students essays on a figure from Greek myth.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' puts THESES round U, giving THESE-U-S; 'set' is just a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: Theseus, slayer of the Minotaur, is a legendary hero of Athenian myth.

clue.text: Classical architecture that you finally get to examine

indicators.note: the final letters of the words are taken

parts.note: to scan is to examine closely

explanation.surface: Ancient buildings you finally get round to inspecting.
explanation.walkthrough: 'finally' takes the last letters of 'that' and 'you', T and U; 'get to' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: The Tuscan order is the plainest of the classical orders of architecture.

clue.text: Work in a cause: that's the aim of running mates

indicators.note: work is placed in the cause, inside it

parts.note: an element can be a contributing factor or cause
op is short for opus, a work

explanation.surface: A campaign slogan about the goal of election running mates.
explanation.walkthrough: 'running mates' suggests a political ticket, but these are lovers running off together.
explanation.definitionFit: Eloping is running away secretly to marry, so it is what fleeing couples are aiming at.

clue.text: Beg companion to avoid difficul leap

indicators.note: letters avoiding the word are left out of it

parts.note: an entrechat is a hard ballet leap with crossing feet; the paper printed difficul for difficult
CH stands for Companion of Honour

explanation.surface: Asking a partner not to try a hard jump.
explanation.walkthrough: The paper itself printed 'difficul' for 'difficult'. 'to avoid' takes CH (Companion of Honour) out of ENTRECHAT.
explanation.definitionFit: To entreat is to plead earnestly, to beg.

clue.text: Cutting out fat

definitions.meaning: a cutting down or abbreviating, making briefer
fat such as lard used in making pastry

explanation.surface: A dieter cuts fat from the menu.
explanation.definitionFit: Shortening means abbreviation, and also the fat that makes pastry crumbly.

clue.text: Shakespeare's surely holding leading position as a writer

indicators.note: one word holding another means it contains it

parts.note: certes is an archaic word for surely, as used in Shakespeare's time
the van, short for vanguard, is the leading position

explanation.surface: Shakespeare is said to have been in pole position among authors.
explanation.walkthrough: 'holding' puts VAN inside CERTES. Shakespeare is not the definition; he only dates the old word.
explanation.definitionFit: Miguel de Cervantes, author of Don Quixote, is the great Spanish novelist, Shakespeare's contemporary.

clue.text: Go one better with barbecue party

definitions.meaning: to surpass someone is to go one better than them
read playfully as an ..., a party (do) held outside

explanation.surface: Someone tries to outshine the neighbours by hosting a barbecue.
explanation.definitionFit: To surpass a rival is to beat them, and a barbecue is jokingly a do held out of doors.

clue.text: Two chaps, mature fellows, start to tackle staff relations

parts.note: a chap is a man, and two of them give the word twice
the second chap, another man
to mature is to age
fellows are men

indicators.note: the start to a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: Two men and some older colleagues begin to deal with an office dispute.
explanation.definitionFit: Handling staff and their relationships with their bosses is the managerial skill of dealing with people.

clue.text: Turner's only lake? Yes and no

parts.note: a winder is something that turns, a turner; the 's is read as 'is'
mere means only, nothing more than

explanation.surface: Asking whether the painter Turner depicted a single lake.
explanation.walkthrough: Turner suggests the painter, but is just a winder. 'Yes and no': it is a lake, yet its name already ends in mere, an old word for lake, so 'Lake' is redundant.
explanation.definitionFit: Windermere is England's largest natural lake, in the Lake District, its name ending in mere.

clue.text: Naive person seen in pub with no money

parts.note: an inn is a pub
no is nothing, the letter O as zero
a cent is a small coin, a sum of money

explanation.surface: A naive drinker is spotted in the pub without a penny to their name.
explanation.definitionFit: An innocent is a guileless, unworldly person lacking experience of wickedness.

clue.text: One enrolled to study handwriting

parts.note: to con is to study or learn by heart
script is handwriting

explanation.surface: A new student signs up to learn calligraphy.
explanation.definitionFit: A conscript is someone compulsorily enlisted into the armed forces.

clue.text: Old cook whipped noisily

indicators.note: said noisily, out loud, so the word is heard rather than written

parts.note: whipped eggs or cream are beaten

explanation.surface: An old cook beats eggs with a great deal of clatter.
explanation.walkthrough: Mrs Beeton was the Victorian author of a famous British book of household management and cookery.
explanation.definitionFit: Isabella Beeton was a nineteenth-century cookery writer, so she is a cook of old.

clue.text: Went and got married again

definitions.meaning: to repair somewhere is to go there
paired up a second time, wed once more

explanation.surface: A couple went off and remarried.
explanation.definitionFit: To repair to a place is to go there, and re-paired means coupled afresh.

clue.text: Tin god excited excessive worship

indicators.note: excited letters are stirred up into a new order

explanation.surface: A petty tyrant revels in being idolised.
explanation.definitionFit: Doting is foolishly excessive fondness or adoration, close to worship.

clue.text: Journey curbed by explosive missile

indicators.note: the journey is held in by the explosive, which surrounds it

parts.note: TNT is a high explosive
a ride is a journey

explanation.surface: A trip is cut short by a bomb.
explanation.definitionFit: Trident is a submarine-launched nuclear ballistic missile system.

clue.text: Lock up electronic device regarding military leadership

parts.note: to pen animals is to lock them up
an electronic tag is fitted to offenders
on means about, regarding

explanation.surface: Fitting an offender with an electronic tag is discussed by army chiefs.
explanation.walkthrough: The Pentagon is the US Department of Defense headquarters, used for its top brass.
explanation.definitionFit: The Pentagon, the US defence headquarters, stands by metonymy for American military command.

clue.text: One protected by kindly Christian

indicators.note: the one is protected by the kindly word, enclosed within it

parts.note: gentle means kindly
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A believer shielded by a benevolent person.
explanation.definitionFit: A gentile is someone not Jewish, such as a Christian.

clue.text: Race body's revolutionary nursery

parts.note: the CRE was the UK Commission for Racial Equality; the 's means 'has'
Che Guevara, the Argentine-born Marxist revolutionary

explanation.surface: An equality watchdog has a radical children's centre.
explanation.walkthrough: The CRE was a British public body promoting racial equality.
explanation.definitionFit: A crèche is a day nursery where infants are cared for.

clue.text: Check plant for new life

parts.note: to rein in is to check or restrain
a carnation is a flowering plant

explanation.surface: Examining a plant for new growth.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Check' looks like the verb examine, but it is the rein that holds a horse back.
explanation.definitionFit: Reincarnation is rebirth of a soul in a new body, a new life.

clue.text: Edition of paper without its heading

indicators.note: losing its heading means the word loses its first letter

parts.note: tissue is a thin paper

explanation.surface: A newspaper copy printed with no headline.
explanation.definitionFit: An issue is one edition of a periodical publication.

clue.text: Old artist turning up without son

indicators.note: in a down clue, turning up reads the word upwards, backwards
the artist without the son letter loses it

parts.note: Edgar Degas was a French Impressionist painter
S is short for son in genealogies

explanation.surface: An elderly painter turns up without his child.
explanation.walkthrough: DEGAS loses S to give DEGA, which 'turning up' reads backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: Aged means old, advanced in years.

clue.text: Resin made from drug and lime mixture

parts.note: E is short for the drug ecstasy

indicators.note: a mixture of lime means its letters jumbled

explanation.surface: A gum produced by blending a narcotic with lime.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mixture' rearranges LIME to LEMI, placed after E.
explanation.definitionFit: Elemi is a fragrant tropical tree resin used in varnishes and ointments.

clue.text: Takes trouble to celebrate stroke play

parts.note: someone who cares takes trouble over something
to sing of something is to celebrate it

explanation.surface: A golfer works hard to celebrate a round of stroke play.
explanation.walkthrough: Stroke play is a golf format, but here it means affectionate stroking.
explanation.definitionFit: Caressing is gentle, loving touching, playful stroking of someone.

clue.text: Allow leaderless 20 little time to enter

indicators.note: the time letter is made to enter the shortened word
without its leader means the word loses its first letter

parts.note: the answer to 20 down, a non-Jew
T is the short form of time

explanation.surface: Permitting a small group to come in after a short delay.
explanation.walkthrough: 'leaderless' turns GENTILE into ENTILE; 'to enter' puts T inside it, after the I.
explanation.definitionFit: To entitle someone is to give them the right, to permit or allow them.

clue.text: Document getting writer in difficult spot

indicators.note: the writer goes in the document, inside it

parts.note: a deed is a legal document
a pen is a writing instrument, a writer

explanation.surface: A legal paper lands an author in trouble.
explanation.walkthrough: 'getting ... in' places PEN inside DEED. The deep end is the swimming pool's deepest part, hence a difficult position.
explanation.definitionFit: Being thrown in at the deep end means facing a hard situation without preparation.
